articles.author: Professional Diversity Network, Inc.
articles.headline: Professional Diversity Network Advances AI Infrastructure Strategy with NVIDIA B300 System Order
articles.summary: The filed issuer release reports an order through AMAX for one NVIDIA B300-based system with 50% paid. Delivery, installation and acceptance remain to follow before planned commercial compute services; an equipment order is not a customer revenue contract or completed deployment.
